title: Inertia of a pair bound through the field

key_results.statement: In the sector $P$ (body 1 as representative, continued to real $P$) the band contract at order $\tau^2$ is the relative chain $h_P$ with bond amplitudes $t(\rho;P)=\kappa_1(\rho)e^{-2iP}+\kappa_2(\rho)$; $r$ even and $r$ odd form separate rings.
At leading order in $\varepsilon$, $M^{(2)}(r)=-2ng_1g_2\ell(r)/t_f$ and the relative potential is $V(r)=\frac{ng_1g_2}{t_fL}r(L-r)$: a well at contact for $g_1g_2>0$, a hill for $g_1g_2<0$.

Under R, B0 (no cancellation of the relative hopping) and $\chi L^3\gg1$, for every branch combination and both signs of $\gamma_1\gamma_2$, bound levels exist (lowest if $\sigma_1\sigma_2\gamma_1\gamma_2>0$, highest if $<0$); the selected level (extreme level at the $k=0$ edge, bodies near rest: lowest if $s_\mu=+1$, highest if $s_\mu=-1$) is bound iff $s_\beta=\mathrm{sgn}[g_1g_2(\mu_1^{-1}+\mu_2^{-1})]=+1$, and then $f_0>0$ on the whole relative ring.

Selected level, $s_\beta=+1$, weak binding $F\ll|\bar t(P)|$, leading order: $E_b(P)=E_1(0)+E_2(0)-E_\varnothing+M(0)-2\bar t_0+s_e[-2|\bar t(P)|+a_0(4|\bar t(P)|F^2)^{1/3}]$, $a_0=1.0188$ the first zero of $\mathrm{Ai}'$, up to $O(\chi^{2/3})$ and $O(\xi_0/L)$.
For the selected level: bond weights $b_0(\rho)=f_0(\rho-1)f_0(\rho+1)>0$, bond overlap $\beta_0=\sum_\rho b_0(\rho)\in(0,1)$, local pair inertia $m(\rho)=-1/(8\kappa_1(\rho))-1/(8\kappa_2(\rho))$.

Exactly for the band contract at order $\tau^2$: $E_b''(0)=E''_{\rm line}(1+\rho_L)$ with $E''_{\rm line}=\sum_\rho b_0(\rho)/m(\rho)$ and the ring remainder $\rho_L$; since $b_0>0$, $E''_{\rm line}$ can vanish only if $m(\rho)$ changes sign along the ring, which B2 excludes.

$m(\rho)=\mu_1+\mu_2+s_c\bar M^{(2)}(\rho)(c_1^{-2}+c_2^{-2})+O(\varepsilon^3(|\mu_1|+|\mu_2|))$: the mutual term enters each body's inertia once over its own speed squared, with $s_c=+1$ for (a) and $-1$ for (c).

Under B2 ($\bar x\ll1$, implying $|A_0|\ll|\mu_1+\mu_2|\beta_0$): $1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2=(\mu_1+\mu_2)(1-\beta_0)/\beta_0+D^{\rm mark}_0-\rho_L/E''_{\rm line}$ up to $O(\varepsilon^3/\beta_0,\bar x^2/\beta_0)$; the lattice part is nonzero with the sign of $\mu_1+\mu_2$; $\beta_0\simeq1-0.270\chi^{2/3}$ (weak), $1/\chi$ (even, tight), $1/2$ (odd, tight); outside B2 (a mark comparable with $|\mu_1+\mu_2|/(c_1^{-2}+c_2^{-2})$) only unexpanded (6.6).

The cost of the bound pair (pair level minus one-body levels plus field alone) is $\Delta E_0=\langle M\rangle_0+K_0$ with the relative kinetic cost $K_0=2\bar t_0(\beta_0-1)$ of sign $s_\mu$, at order $\tau^2$ through $\varepsilon^2$.

Selected level, leading order, both couplings, under R and B: $1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2=\Delta E_0/c^2$ is not an identity on the class for any $c\ge\min(c_1,c_2)$; the coefficients of $K_0$ and of $M(0)$ differ, and the relation fails in every description of case (i) of (6.17).
Weight of the bound level: $W_0(X)=\sum_rf_0(r)^2W_{\rm pair}(X-r/2,X+r/2)$ at first order in $g_s$.
For a distant source, at first order in $g_i$ and $g_s$: $W_0(X+1)-W_0(X-1)=n(g_1+g_2)[\phi(X+1)-\phi(X-1)]+O(\varepsilon^2g_s)$, the weight difference of the members.

(7.7) of 06-ilang-source/07-dressed-fall carries over to the bound level for the centre $\hat Y$ of (6.18): $a_0(0)=-E''_{\rm line}\sum_X\varphi_X^2W'_0(X)[1+O(w^{-2})]+O(\varepsilon^2g_sE''_{\rm line})+O(\tau^4\gamma g_s)$ on the line, the additive remainders being small under (N); the midpoint has in general a different acceleration from rest.

Under R, B and (N) ($
u_g=|g_1+g_2|/\max_i|g_i|$ not small): $\Pi_0= eta_0(\mu_1\Pi_1+\mu_2\Pi_2)/(\mu_1+\mu_2)$ up to relative $O(\varepsilon/
u_g)+O( ar x)$; under $\gamma_1c_1^2=\gamma_2c_2^2$ (where (N) follows from B0) $\Pi_0-\Pi_1=-(1- eta_0)\Pi_1+O(\varepsilon\Pi_1/
u_t)+O( ar x\Pi_1)$: the bound level falls slower than its parts at leading order.

At fixed $n,\gamma_i,M_i,\tau_i$, leading order in $\varepsilon$ with $\mu_i,\bar\kappa_i,\bar t_0,\nu_t,c_i$ at that accuracy ($t_f$-independent): $\chi\propto1/t_f$, $1-\beta_0\simeq0.270\chi^{2/3}$, mark terms fall as $1/t_f$; R1 excludes for $\sigma_i=+1$ the $t_f$ at which a free-field excitation lies within $\delta_1+w$ of $2R_i$, $w=2\max_r|M(r)|+n(|g_1|+|g_2|)$ the margin of this leading-order estimate; $\tau'^2/(\delta_1\delta)\ll1\ll\chi L^3$; no $t_f$ removes (6.10), (6.14).

Ring remainder bound: $|\rho_L|\le\tilde\Phi'(0)^2[2|s_*b_0|+4s_*^2(f_0(r_*)^2+f_0(r_*+2)^2)/\Delta_{\rm rel}]/|E''_{\rm line}|$ at the bond farthest from contact, exponentially small in $L/\xi_0$; $E_b''(0)$ is independent of the continuation to relative accuracy $|\rho_L|$.

Selected level, leading order, under B2, every $c\ge\min(c_1,c_2)$: if $s_c=-\sigma_1\sigma_2$, then $1/E_b''(0)-\mu_1-\mu_2\neq\Delta E_0/c^2$ (under (S) and B4); if $s_c=\sigma_1\sigma_2$, the leading terms have opposite signs and the leading-order expressions vanish where they cancel (codimension one); whether the class or the full contract contains such a description is unverified (gap part of B3 and uniformity of remainders not established along the family).

On the line the plane-wave label $P$ of the bound band is conjugate to the centre $Y=\frac{j+l}{2}+\theta'(l-j)=\frac{\mu_1j+\mu_2l}{\mu_1+\mu_2}+O(\varepsilon^2|l-j|)$; the projected source with $P$-dependent profile has the weight differences of $W_0$ up to $O(\varepsilon^2g_s)$ and relative $O(w^{-2})$.

Under R, B0, B1, B2, to leading order in the omitted terms (beyond order $\tau^2$), the curvature of the bound level of the full sector contract differs from $E_b''(0)$ of (6.6) by at most $\eta_4|E''_{\rm line}|$, $\eta_4=O(\epsilon_4/(\beta_0\nu_t\min_i|\bar\kappa_i|))+O(\epsilon_4/(\beta_0\Delta_{\rm rel}))$, with $\epsilon_4$ the size of the omitted terms (including each body's own order-$\tau^4$ dispersion) and $\Delta_{\rm rel}$ the relative-level gap; B3 is $\eta_4\ll1$.

open_issues: Bound levels with s_β=−1 and excited bound levels are out of scope for items 2–5 (note of 2026-10-21); (6.6) holds for them, but their inertia, cost and fall are not derived.

A near-cancellation of the relative hopping (small ν_t, only for σ_1=−σ_2) is out of scope (note (i)); outside B2 within B0 only the unexpanded (6.6) is available, and the cost comparison and fall factor there are not derived.
The code sets do not meet B4 for the mark terms (|ρ_L| = 0.2–12% against |D^mark| ≈ 0.2–0.3% of 1/E_b''); the code checks (6.6) with the ring term included.
The closed forms (6.2), (6.4), (6.15), (6.17) use the second-order mutual term; at η≈0.3 the exact binding slope is about half of F; statements in terms of β_0, b_0 and M are unaffected.
The O(ε³) remainder of (6.7) is large at moderate couplings (ratio 1.40 for (a), −0.19 for (c) at η≈0.3), so the mark part is reliable only for small η.
The second-order corrections of (6.13), (6.14) are not evaluated (the bond function B of (4.7) is not quoted); 13–16% in the weight differences in the code.
On the ring, (6.13) has a g_s-independent part from the relative cut r=L/2 (up to 0.6% of the first-order part in set A); it is not bounded analytically.

Item 4 where the first-order weights cancel (g_1+g_2 small against max|g_i|) is out of scope (note (ii)); there the first-order fall factor of the pair is small or zero, and the next order is not derived.
In tight binding of the even class β_0∼1/χ and the kinetic part of B3 fails when χ ≳ ν_t min|κ̄_i|/ε_4; the order-τ⁴ band contract is then needed.

The R1 estimate τ'⁴/(δ_1²δ) of ε_4 is crude (in the code 7–180 times the measured omitted terms; it would place set A outside B3); where only this estimate is available, B3 can fail although the omitted terms are small.
For σ_i=+1 and N_f>1 the field excitation energies near 2R_i become dense and the windows of (6.15) shrink; whether weakly coupled resonances can be tolerated is open.

The zero of (6.17)(ii) is established only for the leading-order expressions; along the family of Step 5 the gap part of B3 and the uniformity of the remainders of (2.14), (2.16), (4.3) are not established, so whether the class contains a description with D_0=ΔE_0/c² is open.
Out of scope: full grip, tori, highest field state, bodies of one type, the speed of a front of the field, and how typical the structure is.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions: μ_i, m, 1/E_b'', M̄/c², μ_1μ_2K_0 have [C]^-1; Π_0, Π_i and the acceleration a_0(0) have [C]²; ε_4, Δ_rel, κ̄_i have [C]; β_0, χ, ρ_L, x̄, ν_t, ν_g, η_4 are pure numbers
Unbound limit χ→0 on the line: β_0→1 and 1/E_b''→μ_1+μ_2, the curvature of E_1(p_1)+E_2(p_2) at fixed p_1+p_2 at p_i=0
Tight binding χ→∞: even class E_b''≈s_e·8κ̄_1κ̄_2/F and odd class 1/E_b''=2(μ_1+μ_2), equal to direct perturbation of the contact states
